description:
Change `Filament.Renderer.render/3`'s tuple return: replace `Phoenix.LiveView.Rendered.t()` with the vnode tree (shape settled in flm-3wr.1.1). Update `Filament.Reconciler.mount/3` and `Reconciler.update/4` signatures and return values to thread the vnode tree through.

Substrate callers updated. Web side (`Filament.LiveView`) gets a transitional shim — converts vnode tree to `%Rendered{}` via the existing path so behavior is preserved until flm-3wr.1.4 lands.

## Files

- `lib/filament/renderer.ex`
- `lib/filament/reconciler.ex`
- `lib/filament/live_view.ex` (transitional shim)
- Reconciler tests adjusted to assert on vnode-tree shape.

## Acceptance

- `Filament.Renderer.render/3` and `Filament.Reconciler.mount/3` / `update/4` no longer mention `Phoenix.LiveView.Rendered` in their return types.
- `mix test` passes.
- Transitional shim is clearly marked (TODO/comment) so 1.5 can remove it.
title: Phase 1.2: Renderer + Reconciler return vnode tree
